scope: Limited R22 observation/rule application research, not a complete taxonomy or production detector
hypothesis: XCLIP ranks a bounded set of content windows; a local Qwen observer may verify specific physical conditions rather than answer a broad legal-violation question. Deterministic application of one verified rule may reduce unsupported alarms.
rule_source: Existing verified corpus config/rules.json, NB231 paragraph22; no new norms

proposal.source: Frozen XCLIP-PROTO-01 ordered feature cache and original feature-registration.json
proposal.fit: equal-video centroids inside each original TRAIN group fold, same as frozen XCLIP baseline

observer.model: Existing official Qwen3-VL-4B Q4_K_M plus F16 projector, Apache-2.0; native llama.cpp b11712 MIT
observer.input: One four-frame montage, exact source pixels without second crop/resize; actual decoded PTS
observer.o: Local free observation up to160 characters, physical facts only, never derived from official labels

rule_application.match: R22 only when area=clear,motion=left,service=ongoing,context=sufficient, >=2 distinct support frames, nonempty observation; otherwise no_event
rule_application.type: Fixed verified R22 event name only after observed conditions; never inferred from binary label
rule_application.description: Local observer text plus fixed verified source citation, never cloud generated from real data

controls.legacy_legal_gate: constrained/unconstrained text-only polarity diagnostic, reported separately
controls.new_observer: same four text cases constrained/unconstrained, then four generated diagram sequences constrained
controls.visual_diagrams: Artificial role labels, workplace boundary and status banner; tests composition/OCR/position only, not bank semantics

comparison.baseline: Saved frozen XCLIP ordered_max; all four prior arms retained
comparison.useful_hybrid_gate: No fewer TP than saved baseline, fewer FP, F1>=0.8, all technical controls/sources/cache verified
comparison.latency_scope: Qwen context stage on frozen cached XCLIP features; prior XCLIP extraction is a separately measured reference. Full cold upload/API latency requires a later complete pipeline check and is not claimed here.
comparison.production_gate: Still requires overall recall1 and independent type/rule/evidence validation; binary matches alone cannot validate R22 assignments

stop: If any new synthetic positive/negative observation control fails, stop before TRAIN. No threshold/prompt/topK/rule expansion search. No TUNE/HOLDOUT inference. Preserve baseline, all failed measurements and original labels. No credential/tunnel/submission action.
